## 1. Why can't I register?
Due to legal and regulatory requirements, Bitget sign-up may be unavailable in certain countries or regions, or temporarily restricted in certain jurisdictions or for specific users. Refer to Bitget's Terms and Conditions for the latest information.
If this promotion and CandyBomb have any overlapping eligible coins, users cannot register for both promotions simultaneously.
## 2. Are sub-accounts, institutional accounts, market makers, and PRO accounts eligible to participate in the promotion?
No. Only regular users are eligible to participate in the promotion.
## 3. How is the calculation period for promotion credits set?
Credits are calculated based on the order completion time. For example, if you place an order at 11:59:59 PM on July 24 (UTC+8), but the order is filled at 12:00:15 AM on July 25 (UTC+8), the order amount will be counted toward the promotion credits on July 25.
## 4. Can I win multiple times in the same promotion?
The promotion includes multiple incentive pools, and users are eligible to win from different pools.
## 5. When will the incentives be distributed?
Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within five working days after the promotion ends. You can check your rewards in your spot account. Contact customer service if you have won physical rewards.
## 6. Why didn't I receive any incentives when I met the requirements?
All participants must comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from the promotion and confiscate their incentives in cases of fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim incentives), or other violations.
## 7. Will API trading volume count toward this promotion?
Spot and futures trades are included in your API trading volume. TradFi does not currently support API trading.
## 8. Why is my trading volume not calculated into the promotion?
If a user engages in wash trading or any other fraudulent trading activity (including, but not limited to, self-trading and improper matched orders) to obtain promotional rewards, Bitget reserves the right to exclude such trading activity from the promotion's eligible trading volume. In serious cases, Bitget may disqualify the user from the promotion and reclaim or forfeit any rewards already granted.

All KuCoin users who complete at least $250 spot trading volume of INFI during the campaign period will qualify for the Lucky Draw.
